reuse.why: Reuses recurrence conversion and weekend adjustment helpers, but implements daily exclusion separately in getNextDate and getDatesInRange.

duplication.why: Daily exclusion and the conditional adjustment pipeline are repeated across shared scheduling logic and server handlers.

placement.why: Holiday matching belongs in shared/schedules.ts, but the server range handler also owns scheduling policy that should be shared.

scope.why: All edits directly support the requested scheduling rules, range handler, configuration field, or associated tests.

maintainability.why: Maintainers must coordinate several policy implementations, occurrence-search limits, and consumers that still apply only the older adjustment rules.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getDatesInRange directly enumerates and filters occurrences instead of sharing the occurrence policy implemented in getNextDate.

disguised_duplication.where: The daily exclusion predicate appears as a dates.find predicate in getNextDate and an inverted continue condition in getDatesInRange.

abstraction_drift.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend gains holidays; getNextDate adds daily-specific take, selection, and adjustment branches; getDatesInRange, getUpcomingDates, and both adjustment sites in budget/schedule-template.ts independently apply or bypass parts of the occurrence policy.
